label: Shawl 0005
description: The Shawl 0005 carries the shawl collar as one continuous edge, running unbroken from the back of the neck down each front. Its defining proportion is a steep narrowing: the lapel leaves the collar at a moderate depth and has lost roughly two fifths of it by the bottom, the outer edge closing steadily inward the whole way down. That outer edge is drawn very nearly straight, close to a ruled line from the shoulder to the bottom with only the slightest bow to it. It finishes in a very acute point where the two front edges converge, markedly finer than the depth at the top would suggest, with a slender tail running on below the meeting. The roll is pressed soft so the collar lies flat and the long straight closing edge is legible along its entire run.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
